audit.method: Canonical Emerald metatile collision bits 10-11; each 64px source metatile repeats 2x2 into 32px collision cells.
audit.spawn_policy: Largest component first except the reviewed Route 125 underwater western entrance pool; maximum obstacle clearance, then other substantial floor components (128 cells on surface; 24 underwater); surface spawns require canonical water/current behaviors, excluding decorative MB_MOUNTAIN_TOP pockets. No terrain overrides.
audit.traversal: Surface ocean, currents and underwater floor are traversable; canonical collision flags block rocks, cliffs and raised underwater terrain.
